description: Checks address parts against the country's format and searches the postal code directory for the postal code. Takes street, line2, postalCode, city, region and countryCode (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in lowercase, such as de), each optional. Returns address (the parts as a write stores them: the postal code in the country's format, a region name turned into the country's region code), issues, and postalCode.places: the cities and regions the postal code directory lists for the postal code, most likely first, with postalCode.match exact when the directory knows the code, plus an attribution credit for the places. An issue with severity error means writing this address to a record is refused; a warning does not stop a write. Nothing leaves the server. postalCode.status loading means the country's postal codes are being loaded, which takes about a minute.

countryCode.description: Only addresses in this country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in lowercase, such as de.

line2.description: Apartment, floor or c/o; kept as entered and not checked.

street.description: Street with house number, as written in the country.

workspace.description: Slug or id of the workspace to work in. Optional when the account has exactly one usable workspace; required when it has several. An API key always works in its own workspace.

name: check_address

address.description: The parts as a write stores them: trimmed, the postal code in the country's format, the region as the country's code, and the centre of the postal code as location when the directory knows the code.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code in lowercase, such as de.

formatted.description: One-line address the server formats from the parts; a sent value is replaced.

precision.description: address: the building, from an address lookup; postcode: the centre of the postal code.

location.description: Owned by the server: coordinates for maps, from an address lookup or the postal code.

verification.description: Owned by the server: only a lookup candidateToken stores a verified address.

attribution.description: Source credit for places from the postal code directory.

code.description: Errors: countryUnknown (not an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code), postalCodeInvalid (does not fit the country's format), regionInvalid (a code that is not one of the country's region codes). Warnings: countryMissing, partMissing, regionUnknown, postalCodeRegionMismatch, cityMismatch.

example.description: postalCodeInvalid: a postal code in the country's format.

expected.description: cityMismatch: cities of the postal code; postalCodeRegionMismatch: its region codes.

message.description: The issue as an English sentence.

severity.description: error: writing this address is refused; warning: the address is saved and the warning returned.

match.description: exact: the directory knows the postal code (or the area it lists for the country); area: only a broader area matched, so places are approximate; none: unknown to the directory.

places.description: Cities and regions of the postal code, most likely first.

region.description: The country's region code, as an address field stores it, or null.

status.description: ready: the directory was searched; loading: the country's postal codes are being loaded, which takes about a minute; unavailable: no directory for this country or it is switched off on this server; notChecked: no country, no postal code, or an error above.

title: Check an address
